name: Should I use a flat, eggshell, satin, or semi-gloss paint finish for my interior walls?

mainEntity.name: Should I use a flat, eggshell, satin, or semi-gloss paint finish for my interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice of paint finish depends on the room's function and desired durability. Flat finishes offer a non-reflective, elegant look, ideal for low-traffic areas like formal dining rooms and ceilings. Eggshell is a popular choice for living rooms and bedrooms, providing a subtle sheen with better durability than flat. Satin offers more sheen and washability, suitable for kitchens and bathrooms. Semi-gloss is highly durable and easy to clean, best for trim, doors, and high-moisture areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose flat for low-traffic areas, eggshell for living rooms, satin for kitchens and bathrooms, and semi-gloss for trim and high-moisture areas. Each finish offers different durability and sheen.
